Stage 5 · Java foundations

Overriding: Tailored Jackets

Same signature, new behavior. @Override proves intent.

⏱ 12 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Same jacket, new cut

Measurements must match exactly.

✂️

Tailor shop. Parent speak() says “…”. Dog re-cuts it to “Woof!”. @Override tag = “deliberate”. Different inputs? That’s OVERLOADING — a different shop (compile-time choice).

Dog sketch
class Animal {
  void speak() { System.out.println("..."); }
}
class Dog extends Animal {
  @Override
  void speak() { System.out.println("Woof!"); } // tailored
}
Animal a = new Dog(); // reference Animal, object Dog
a.speak(); // "Woof!" — the OBJECT decides
Object decides at runtime: Animal a = new Dog(); a.speak() barks. Dynamic dispatch powers polymorphism.
